hotel_name: The St. Regis Al Mouj Muscat Resort

skipped.reason: no Condé Nast Traveler hotel page found for this name

claims.text: The resort stretches along a 360-meter beachfront in Muscat, Oman.

findings.quote: Stretching along a 360-meter beachfront, The St. Regis Al Mouj Muscat Resort graces the shores of the Sultanate of Oman as a five-star resort in Muscat

claims.text: The resort is in Al Mouj, near the marina, the airport, the opera house and the islands.

findings.quote: this Muscat resort offers a prime location in Al Mouj near the marina, airport, opera house, and islands

claims.text: Muscat International Airport is approximately 8.1 kilometers from the hotel.

findings.quote: The closest airport near The St. Regis Al Mouj Muscat Resort is Muscat International Airport (MCT). MCT is located approximately 8.1 KM from the hotel.

claims.text: The Al Mouj Golf Course is a par-72 championship course stretching along a six-kilometer coastline.

findings.quote: the award-winning Al Mouj Golf Course, designed by golfing legend Greg Norman
Stretching along a six-kilometer coastline, this par-72 championship course offers lush green fairways, challenging bunkers, and natural dunes.

claims.text: Rooms and suites are inspired by luxury yachts and nautical themes.

findings.quote: 250 elegantly designed rooms and suites, each thoughtfully inspired by the elegance of luxury yachts and nautical themes

claims.text: Dining venues at the resort include COYA, Em Sherif and Hakkasan.

findings.quote: thirteen distinctive dining venues such as COYA, Em Sherif, and Hakkasan

claims.text: Afternoon Tea at The Lounge draws inspiration from the parties once hosted by Caroline Astor.

findings.quote: drawing inspiration from the lavish parties once hosted by Caroline Astor. At The Lounge, in the heart of the resort

claims.text: The Guerlain Spa has wet facilities with steam rooms and saunas.

findings.quote: Nestled within our resort, Guerlain Spa blends indulgence and serenity. With 11 treatment rooms, including 2 couple suites, and wet facilities featuring steam rooms and saunas

claims.text: The Guerlain Spa offers a wellness menu inspired by Omani philosophy and spirits.

findings.quote: Guerlain Spa presents a bespoke wellness menu inspired by Omani philosophy and spirits

claims.text: Watersports at the resort include paddleboarding, kayaking and snorkeling; sunset cruises are available on request.

findings.quote: Discover an array of watersports at our resort, including paddleboarding, kayaking, and snorkeling.
Additional activities are available upon request, such as sunset cruises along Muscat

claims.text: The Adventure Hub kids club has a games and TV area, an art and craft corner, a reading corner and a kids pool.

findings.quote: The Adventure Hub, our kids club with engaging activities for children of all ages
Our facility features a Games & TV area, Art & Craft Corner, Reading Corner, and a Kids Pool, ensuring endless fun and creativity.

claims.text: St. Regis butlers are available around the clock.

findings.quote: Our butlers are available around the clock

claims.text: The Al Mouj Golf Course, designed by Greg Norman, is a few steps from the resort.

findings.quote: Just a few steps away from our resort, the award-winning Al Mouj Golf Course, designed by golfing legend Greg Norman

claims.text: The Royal Suite has a private infinity pool and two jacuzzis.

findings.quote: This stunning suite offers a private infinity pool and two jacuzzis

claims.text: Karibu serves breakfast and dinner, blending Omani specialties with influences from Zanzibar to India, inspired by the spice route.

findings.quote: Inspired by the historic spice route, Karibu creates a captivating setting for breakfast and dinner, blending Omani specialties with influences from Zanzibar to India.

claims.text: At Zorba, Chef Thanos recreates his grandmother's recipes from the Greek Islands.

findings.quote: Chef Thanos infuses each dish with passion and authenticity, recreating his grandmother's cherished recipes from the Greek Islands.

claims.text: The duplex suites include a private deck with a plunge pool and direct access to the resort pool.

findings.quote: our 1, 2, and 3 bedroom duplex suites provide the perfect backdrop for treasured family moments
Luxurious amenities include a private deck complete with plunge pool and direct access to the resort

claims.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.

findings.quote: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the resort is outside central Muscat, so exploring the city requires transportation.
Pets are not allowed at the resort.

findings.quote: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Al Mouj Muscat Resort.
